cases.source: Nora proposed that the publications team distribute the revised handbook only once the compliance team approves the safety appendix. Compliance has not approved the appendix, and publications has not distributed the handbook. The transport team separately discussed shuttle routes.

rubric: compliance approval of safety appendix prerequisite
